hanoi.name: Ha Noi
hanoi.desc: The thousand-year-old capital, blending the antiquity of the Old Quarter with the dynamism of a modern metropolis.

haiphong.name: Hai Phong
haiphong.desc: A bustling port city famous for its street food and as the gateway to the poetic Cat Ba Island.

vandon.name: Van Don
vandon.desc: A beautiful island district in Quang Ninh, known for its pristine Bai Dai beach and direct connection to Ha Long Bay.

thanhhoa.name: Thanh Hoa
thanhhoa.desc: A land of masterpieces, famous for the vibrant Sam Son beach and Pu Luong nature reserve.

vinh.name: Vinh
vinh.desc: The heroic red city, hometown of Uncle Ho. A destination for Cua Lo beach tourism and historical sites.

dienbien.name: Dien Bien Phu
dienbien.desc: A historic land with a world-famous victory. Explore A1 Hill and the white ban flowers of the Northwest.

danang.name: Da Nang
danang.desc: The most livable city in Vietnam with My Khe beach, Dragon Bridge, and Ba Na Hills.

hue.name: Hue
hue.desc: The quiet, dreamy ancient capital by the Perfume River. Keeping the royal culture and court music.

nhatrang.name: Nha Trang
nhatrang.desc: The pearl of the Far East with the most beautiful bays in the world. Paradise for diving and VinWonders.

quynhon.name: Quy Nhon
quynhon.desc: A peaceful poetic city with Eo Gio, Ky Co is considered the Vietnamese version of Maldives.

quangnam.name: Quang Nam
quangnam.desc: Heritage land with romantic Hoi An Ancient Town and mysterious My Son Sanctuary.

donghoi.name: Dong Hoi
donghoi.desc: The kingdom of caves with majestic Phong Nha - Ke Bang and the world's largest Son Doong cave.

tuyhoa.name: Tuy Hoa
tuyhoa.desc: The land of yellow flowers on green grass. Admire the unique Ganh Da Dia and Dai Lanh lighthouse.

dalat.name: Da Lat
dalat.desc: City of a thousand flowers in the mist. A romantic destination with a cool climate and pine hills.

buonmathuot.name: Buon Ma Thuot
buonmathuot.desc: The coffee capital of Vietnam. Ride elephants in Ban Don, watch Dray Nur waterfall.

pleiku.name: Pleiku
pleiku.desc: The poetic Eyes of Pleiku Sea Lake. Explore the wild beauty of the great forest.

hcm.name: Ho Chi Minh City
hcm.desc: The vibrant Pearl of the Far East, the country's largest economic center. A hub of cuisine and entertainment.

phuquoc.name: Phu Quoc
phuquoc.desc: Resort paradise with luxury resorts, white sand Sao Beach, and the world's longest sea-crossing cable car.

cantho.name: Can Tho
cantho.desc: Capital of the river West. Experience the bustling Cai Rang floating market and fruit orchards.

condao.name: Con Dao
condao.desc: Spiritual tourism and pristine resort destination. Explore history and dive to see coral.

rachgia.name: Rach Gia
rachgia.desc: A peaceful Western coastal city, gateway to Nam Du Island and Phu Quoc.

camau.name: Ca Mau
camau.desc: The southernmost point of the country. Conquer the national coordinate landmark and vast mangrove forests.
